jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}明日[あした]雨[あめ]が降[ふ]っても、試合[しあい]は行[おこな]われます。
en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will be held.
why: たとえ introduces a hypothetical concession that ends in ても; まるで needs ようだ and きっと expresses conviction.

jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}みんなに反対[はんたい]されても、私[わたし]は自分[じぶん]の夢[ゆめ]をあきらめない。
en: Even if everyone opposes me, I won't give up my dream.
why: A hypothetical "even if" with ても takes たとえ; the other adverbs do not pair with ても.

jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}失敗[しっぱい]しても、挑戦[ちょうせん]したことに意味[いみ]がある。
en: Even if you fail, there is meaning in having tried.
why: Failure is a hypothetical event, so たとえ…ても is used; あまり needs a negative and まるで needs ようだ.

jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}お金[かね]がなくても、幸[しあわ]せに暮[く]らせると思[おも]います。
en: Even if we have no money, I think we can live happily.
why: たとえ…ても concedes an imagined situation; まるで, きっと and ぜひ cannot be followed by ても like this.

jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}一人[ひとり]になっても、最後[さいご]までこの仕事[しごと]を続[つづ]けるつもりだ。
en: Even if I end up alone, I intend to continue this work to the end.
why: A hypothetical situation conceded with ても takes たとえ; たぶん and きっと express guesses, not concessions.

jp: {たとえ|av-tatoe}社長[しゃちょう]に頼[たの]まれても、悪[わる]いことはできません。
en: Even if the president asked me, I could not do something wrong.
why: たとえ marks an imagined "even if" case; the other adverbs do not combine with ても.

jp: {たとえ/いくら|av-tatoe}冗談[じょうだん]でも、そんなことを言[い]ってはいけません。
en: Even as a joke, you must not say such things.
why: たとえ…でも concedes a hypothetical case ("even if it is a joke"); the other adverbs do not.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}食[た]べても、彼[かれ]は太[ふと]らない。
en: No matter how much he eats, he doesn't put on weight.
why: "No matter how much" with ても is いくら (or どんなに); あまり needs a plain negative and きっと cannot precede ても.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}探[さが]しても、鍵[かぎ]が見[み]つかりません。
en: No matter how hard I look, I can't find the key.
why: いくら…ても expresses "no matter how much" effort; the other adverbs do not.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}注意[ちゅうい]しても、弟[おとうと]は同[おな]じ間違[まちが]いをする。
en: No matter how often I warn him, my younger brother makes the same mistake.
why: Repeated effort with no result is いくら…ても; たぶん and きっと do not take ても.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}勉強[べんきょう]しても、漢字[かんじ]がなかなか覚[おぼ]えられない。
en: No matter how much I study, I just can't memorise kanji.
why: "No matter how much I study" is いくら…ても; the other adverbs cannot take ても.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}呼[よ]んでも、犬[いぬ]は来[き]てくれなかった。
en: No matter how much I called, the dog didn't come.
why: いくら…ても describes effort that fails to change the result; the others do not combine with ても.

jp: {いくら/どんなに/たとえ|av-tatoe}高[たか]くても、この時計[とけい]がほしい。
en: No matter how expensive it is, I want this watch.
why: "However expensive" with ても takes いくら or どんなに (たとえ also works); ぜひ and きっと cannot.

jp: {いくら/どんなに|av-tatoe}頼[たの]んでも、店[みせ]の人[ひと]は教[おし]えてくれなかった。
en: No matter how much I asked, the shop staff would not tell me.
why: いくら…ても means "no matter how much"; the other options do not take ても.

jp: {どんなに/いくら|av-tatoe}難[むずか]しくても、あきらめずに挑戦[ちょうせん]します。
en: However difficult it is, I will take up the challenge without giving up.
why: "However difficult" with ても is どんなに; the others cannot go with ても.

jp: {どんなに/いくら|av-tatoe}疲[つか]れていても、子供[こども]の笑顔[えがお]を見[み]ると元気[げんき]が出[で]る。
en: However tired I am, I feel better when I see my child's smile.
why: どんなに…ても means "however much"; あまり needs a plain negative and きっと cannot precede ても.

jp: {どんなに/いくら/たとえ|av-tatoe}遠[とお]くても、あなたに会[あ]いに行[い]きます。
en: However far it is, I will go to see you.
why: "However far" with ても takes どんなに or いくら (たとえ also works); the others cannot.

jp: {どんなに/いくら/たとえ|av-tatoe}眠[ねむ]くても、今日[きょう]中[じゅう]にこのレポートを終[お]わらせなければならない。
en: However sleepy I am, I have to finish this report today.
why: "However sleepy" with ても takes どんなに; たぶん and きっと express guesses and do not take ても.

jp: {どんなに/いくら/たとえ|av-tatoe}大変[たいへん]でも、最後[さいご]まで頑張[がんば]りたいです。
en: However hard it gets, I want to keep going to the end.
why: "However hard" with でも is どんなに or いくら; the other adverbs do not combine with でも.

jp: {どんなに/いくら|av-tatoe}外[そと]が寒[さむ]くても、この部屋[へや]は暖[あたた]かいです。
en: However cold it is outside, this room is warm.
why: "However cold" with ても takes どんなに; the others cannot be used with ても.

jp: {どんなに/いくら|av-tatoe}謝[あやま]っても、彼女[かのじょ]は許[ゆる]してくれなかった。
en: No matter how much I apologised, she would not forgive me.
why: どんなに…ても means "no matter how much" and fits a result that did not change; the others do not.

jp: たとえ嫌[きら]いな食[た]べ物[もの]{でも|av-tatoe}、一口[ひとくち]は食[た]べなさい。
en: Even if it is a food you dislike, eat at least one bite.
why: たとえ is completed by でも ("even if it is"); だったら gives a plain "if" and なので/だから give a reason.

jp: たとえ時間[じかん]が{かかっても|av-tatoe}、正[ただ]しい方法[ほうほう]でやりたい。
en: Even if it takes time, I want to do it the right way.
why: たとえ pairs with ても; たら, ので and なら do not give the "even if" concession.

jp: いくら{安[やす]くても|av-tatoe}、品質[ひんしつ]が悪[わる]ければ買[か]いません。
en: No matter how cheap it is, I won't buy it if the quality is bad.
why: いくら takes ても; ので gives a reason, のに means "although" and ないと is a requirement.

jp: いくら{言[い]っても|av-tatoe}、息子[むすこ]は部屋[へや]を片付[かたづ]けません。
en: No matter how much I tell him, my son won't tidy his room.
why: いくら…ても means "no matter how much"; たら, ので and なら do not.

jp: どんなに{練習[れんしゅう]しても|av-tatoe}、あの曲[きょく]は上手[じょうず]に弾[ひ]けない。
en: However much I practise, I can't play that piece well.
d: 練習[れんしゅう]したら
練習[れんしゅう]するので
練習[れんしゅう]するなら
why: どんなに is completed by ても; the other forms would not mean "however much".

jp: どんなに{急[いそ]いでも|av-tatoe}、九時[くじ]の電車[でんしゃ]には間[ま]に合[あ]わないだろう。
en: However much we hurry, we probably won't catch the nine o'clock train.
why: どんなに…ても concedes any amount of effort; たら, ので and なら give the wrong logic.

jp: たとえ試験[しけん]に{落[お]ちても|av-tatoe}、また受[う]ければいいよ。
en: Even if you fail the exam, you can just take it again.
why: たとえ takes ても for an "even if" concession; the other forms do not fit with たとえ.

jp: たとえ体[からだ]が{小[ちい]さくても|av-tatoe}、あきらめなければ勝[か]てる。
en: Even if your body is small, you can win if you don't give up.
why: たとえ is completed by ても; ので gives a reason, のに means "although" and ないと is a requirement.

jp: いくら{忙[いそが]しくても|av-tatoe}、食事[しょくじ]だけはきちんととるようにしている。
en: No matter how busy I am, I make a point of eating properly.
why: いくら takes ても; ので and のに state facts rather than "no matter how".

jp: たとえ子供[こども]{でも|av-tatoe}、約束[やくそく]は守[まも]らなければならない。
en: Even a child must keep promises.
why: たとえ…でも means "even if it is"; なので and だから give a reason, and なら is a plain condition.

jp: どんなに{悲[かな]しくても|av-tatoe}、人前[ひとまえ]では泣[な]かないようにしている。
en: However sad I am, I try not to cry in front of others.
why: どんなに is completed by ても; ので/から give a reason and のに means "although".

jp: いくら{払[はら]っても|av-tatoe}、借金[しゃっきん]は減[へ]らなかった。
en: No matter how much I paid, the debt didn't decrease.
why: いくら…ても means "no matter how much"; たら, ので and なら do not.

jp: たとえ{断[ことわ]られても|av-tatoe}、もう一度[いちど]お願[ねが]いしてみます。
en: Even if I am turned down, I will ask once more.
why: たとえ takes ても for an "even if" concession; the other forms do not.

jp: どんなに{考[かんが]えても|av-tatoe}、答[こた]えは出[で]なかった。
en: No matter how much I thought, I couldn't come up with an answer.
why: どんなに…ても means "no matter how much"; the other forms break the logic.

jp: たとえ天気[てんき]が{悪[わる]くても|av-tatoe}、遠足[えんそく]は予定[よてい]どおり行[おこな]います。
en: Even if the weather is bad, the school trip will go ahead as planned.
why: たとえ takes ても; ば would give a plain "if" and ので/のに state a real fact or contrast.

jp: いくら{電話[でんわ]しても|av-tatoe}、彼[かれ]は出[で]ない。
en: No matter how often I call him, he doesn't pick up.
why: いくら…ても means "no matter how often"; たら, ので and なら do not.

jp: どんなに{お金持[かねも]ちでも|av-tatoe}、時間[じかん]は買[か]えない。
en: No matter how rich you are, you can't buy time.
d: お金持[かねも]ちなので
お金持[かねも]ちだから
why: どんなに is completed by でも ("however rich"); ので/だから give reasons and なら is a plain condition.

jp: たとえ{寂[さび]しくても|av-tatoe}、泣[な]かないと決[き]めた。
en: Even if I feel lonely, I have decided not to cry.
why: たとえ takes ても for a concession; ので/から give reasons and のに means "although".

jp: いくら{好[す]きでも|av-tatoe}、毎日[まいにち]カレーでは飽[あ]きます。
en: No matter how much you like it, you get tired of curry every day.
why: いくら is completed by でも ("however much you like it"); なら, ので and だから do not concede.
